question:
Choose the idiom/phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

The police have been **investigating **his accounts looking for evidence of fraud.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"investigating"** means examining or looking into something thoroughly to discover facts or information. (जाँच करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The detective spent months** investigating** the case to find the real culprit.
 
 
 
• **"Digging around"** refers to searching for information or trying to find out more about something. (तलाश करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She has been **digging around** in the archives to find any information about her ancestors.
 
 
 
• Hence, the phrase **"digging around" **is a suitable substitute for the highlighted group of words "investigating his accounts looking for evidence of fraud".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Through thick and thin** (हर परिस्थिति में): Under all circumstances, no matter how difficult.

 
 
• **Example:** They have remained friends through thick and thin.
 
 
 
• **In the dark** (अनजान): Without knowledge or information.
 
 
• **Example:** I was kept in the dark about the company's new policy changes.
 
 
 
• **Hitting the hay** (सो जाना): Going to bed or going to sleep.
 
 
• **Example:** I'm really tired, so I think I'll be hitting the hay soon.
